doc: An insert into a one-line YAML flow sequence and a removal from it (databricks.fbl#configuration; FBL 0.10, sections 4.3 and 6.2; spec 066, User Story 2, scenario 5). b's depends_on is written [{task_key: a}]; the dependency added is on c, since in this body that list is b's own and a dependency of b on b would wait for itself. Its body, flow-dependencies.yml, is etalii.adp.ide.standalone's src/diagrams/databricks/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.Databricks.Tests/Fixtures/flow-dependencies.yml at ad1a4680a, byte for byte (CRLF).

steps.doc: A dependency of b on c is written inside the one-line flow sequence, after ', ', in flow form: one insert-entry before its ] (FBL 0.10, section 6.2, Flow sequences).

expectFiles.../flow-dependencies.yml:
resources:
  jobs:
    flow_dependencies:
      name: Dependencies written on one line
      tasks:
        - task_key: b
          depends_on: [{task_key: a}, {task_key: c}]
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/b
        - task_key: a
          notebook_task: {notebook_path: notebooks/a}
        - task_key: c
          notebook_task:
            notebook_path: notebooks/c

steps.doc: Removing it again is a remove-entry of the item and one separator, for the last item the one before it with the whitespace between: the line is as it was.
